name: Signal Function Set
_comment: Build script will modify slug/name/version for dev builds to allow coexistence
author: Stuart Frederich-Smith

modules.name: Drift
modules.description: Four phase-shifted LFOs with offset and Lorenz chaos.

modules.name: GSX
modules.description: Granular synthesis after Barry Truax's GSX system.

modules.name: Fugue
modules.description: 8-step harmonic sequencer with three CV/gate voices.

modules.name: Phase
modules.description: Dual sample looper whose two loops drift out of phase.

modules.name: Overtone
modules.description: Additive VCO with eight harmonics you switch on and off.

modules.name: Intone
modules.description: Formant voice after CHANT/FOF, with vowel morphing.

modules.name: Tine
modules.description: Pingable resonator after the Gamelan Resonator circuit.

modules.name: Fugue X
modules.description: Expander for Fugue with per-voice steps, range and sleep.

modules.name: MetaFugue
modules.description: Fugue and Fugue X combined on one panel.

modules.name: Meter
modules.description: Musical clock with time signatures and per-output swing.

modules.name: Meter X
modules.description: Expander for Meter with a 24 PPQN clock and bar triggers.

modules.name: Beat
modules.description: Per-voice drum sequencer with velocity and accent.

modules.name: Note
modules.description: Monophonic CV/gate sequencer with a 12-note pitch matrix.

modules.name: Swell
modules.description: Envelope where each ping adds another rise on top.

modules.name: Shift
modules.description: Four-lane CV shift register with delay and cascade.

modules.name: Wave
modules.description: Parametric wavetable voice built from eight snapshots.

modules.name: Vac
modules.description: A/R envelope with vactrol-like drift in its timing.

modules.name: Muse
modules.description: Triadex Muse recreation with theme and interval sliders.

modules.name: Gravity
modules.description: X/Y CV and gates from six chaotic motion models.

modules.name: Band
modules.description: Four bandpass filters locked to harmonics of one pitch.

modules.name: Cycle
modules.description: Quad LFO locked to the bar, with morphable shapes.

modules.name: Operator
modules.description: DX7-style six-operator FM voice that loads .syx banks.

modules.name: OP ENV
modules.description: A DX7 operator envelope, loaded from .syx, fired by a gate.

modules.name: Chance
modules.description: Sequencer that plays a seeded melodic walk with random branches.

modules.name: Record
modules.description: Auto-sampler that plays a voice and writes WAVs and an .sfz.

modules.name: Play
modules.description: Polyphonic sample player for SFZ and DecentSampler.

modules.name: Ratio
modules.description: Quad VCA that sends one signal to four outputs at set ratios.

modules.name: Arrange
modules.description: Song sequencer of eight phrases with their own key and tempo.

modules.name: Fill
modules.description: Auto-playing drum sequencer that generates fills and variations.

modules.name: Chime
modules.description: Eight-note drone machine with rotating resonator tubes.

modules.name: Crystal
modules.description: Echo chamber modelled on real crystal shapes, with four outputs.

modules.name: Loom
modules.description: Eight waveguide strings sharing one resonant bridge.

modules.name: Key
modules.description: Four-channel quantizer that reads its root and scale as CV.

modules.name: Slide
modules.description: Electric lap steel model with eight strings and a steel bar.

modules.name: OP MORPH
modules.description: Expander for Operator that blends between DX7 algorithms.

modules.name: SLIDE XP
modules.description: Expander for Slide with a gate input and output per string.

modules.name: Slice
modules.description: Cuts live audio into slices and reverses, repeats or reorders them.

modules.name: Kit
modules.description: Eight physically modelled drums, including a two-plate hi-hat.

modules.name: PolyKit In
modules.description: Expander for Kit with a jack for every input of every drum.

modules.name: Field
modules.description: Nineteen random voltages sampled from one smooth noise field.

modules.name: Trace
modules.description: Four CV lanes on a scrolling loop, drawn by mouse or by CV.

modules.name: Sigma
modules.description: Additive voice of up to 64 partials, morphed by velocity.

modules.name: Touch
modules.description: Adds slides, hammer-ons and re-picks to a V/OCT and gate melody.

modules.name: Wheel
modules.description: Hurdy-gurdy drone model with six strings and a cranked wheel.

modules.name: Helix
modules.description: Barber-pole phaser with notches locked to the harmonic series.

modules.name: Brigade
modules.description: Shifts audio upward through frequency bands, softer at each step.

modules.name: Spool
modules.description: Four-tape sampler where each tape resumes from where it stopped.

modules.name: Flock
modules.description: Granular voice driven by a simulated flock of birds.

modules.name: Flock In
modules.description: Expander for Flock that feeds live audio to its grains.

modules.name: Canon
modules.description: Four arpeggiators playing from one chord progression.

modules.name: Count
modules.description: Clock with six gate outputs set by rate and step mask.

modules.name: Carillon
modules.description: Modelled bells that pass a strike along rods you draw.

modules.name: Strata
modules.description: Wavetable voice that reads from a 3D grid of frames.

modules.name: Cistern
modules.description: Reverb modelled on real rooms, scanned or built from plans.

modules.name: Hocket
modules.description: Routes one line of notes or audio to eight channels in turn.

modules.name: Concrète
modules.description: Four-lane clip sampler on a 1-8 bar tape loop with automation.

modules.name: Concrète In
modules.description: Expander for Concrète that records each lane from its own input.

modules.name: Canopy
modules.description: Steel tongue drum played by drops falling through leaves you place.
